# Font Awesome icons in phone-ui's fonts, beyond LVGL's symbols (LV_SYMBOL_*): one a
# line, its name and codepoint as Font Awesome's metadata/icons.yml gives them, then its
# style, solid (if left out) or regular, from Font Awesome 7 Free (the flake's
# FONTAWESOME). gen-fonts.sh adds their glyphs to every ui_font_<size> and writes
# src/ui_symbols.h: UI_SYMBOL_<NAME> (UI_SYMBOL_<NAME>_REGULAR for regular), a UTF-8
# string for a label, as LV_SYMBOL_* are. A solid icon on a codepoint of LVGL's symbols is
# refused (both are Font Awesome's: its glyph would replace LVGL's); regular ones move to
# U+F0000 + their codepoint, as they share Solid's.
#
# Icons: https://fontawesome.com/search?ic=free

tower-broadcast f519	# mobile data: the shade's tile
tower-cell e585	# the mobile network: the shade's row
sun f185	# brightness, bright: the shade's slider, Settings' slider's end
sun f185 regular	# brightness, dim: the shade's slider, Settings' slider's start
sim-card f7c4	# no SIM: the status bar, after the signal bars
lock f023	# SIM locked (PIN) or blocked (PUK): the status bar, after the signal bars
language f1ab	# Settings: the Language row
